conclusion: On clean labels at seed 7, OLS achieved lower MSE (0.17046895861013783) than the matched training-mean predictor (12.888358499556563). Verification of evidence-1 passed all checks (manifest hash, csv hashes, split sizes, training fit, saved predictions, recomputed metrics), with recomputed MSE for the linear model at 0.1704689586101377. This remains a preliminary single-seed, single-metric result and does not establish general scientific value.
limitations: Only seed 7 was run; seeds 19 and 31 were not executed.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not executed.
Single-seed, single-metric result; no uncertainty estimate or significance test.
Recomputed linear MSE differs from the reported value at the ~1e-16 level (0.1704689586101377 vs 0.17046895861013783), consistent with floating-point rounding.
